title: [3.3.0 Beta1] CGM Button can't be made visible on main screen.
body:
On the Main screen of the above mentioned beta Version the CGM button is not shown on main screen despite activation in menu.

Rig: N6000 + Diakem G7 App + G7

comments.body:
On android 11 it's not possible to detect installed applications.
Thus this feature had to been removed for Dexcom.
It's still available for xdrip
